items.title: E-Commerce Platform
items.description: A comprehensive e-commerce platform built with React and Node.js featuring product catalog, shopping cart, payment integration, and admin dashboard for inventory management.

items.title: Mobile Banking App
items.description: Cross-platform banking application with secure authentication, transaction history, fund transfers, and real-time notifications using React Native and Firebase.

items.title: Real-time Chat System
items.description: High-performance real-time messaging system with WebSocket support, message encryption, user presence tracking, and scalable backend architecture using Node.js and Redis.

items.title: React Dashboard
items.description: Interactive analytics dashboard with real-time data visualization, customizable widgets, and responsive design. Built with React, TypeScript, and Chart.js.

items.title: Cloud Management System
items.description: Enterprise cloud resource management platform with automated deployment, monitoring, and scaling capabilities. Built with React, Express, and cloud APIs.

items.title: iOS Social App
items.description: Native iOS social networking application featuring user profiles, feed management, photo sharing, and real-time notifications using Swift and Firebase.
